title: Primacy of Existence (Asalat al-Wujud) & Substantial Motion
summary: Mulla Sadra's foundational thesis in Transcendent Theosophy asserting that existence (wujud) is the sole objective reality, while essences (mahiyyat) are cognitive abstractions. Physical substances undergo continuous intrinsic motion (al-harakah al-jawhariyyah), dynamically evolving in ontological intensity toward immaterial consciousness.
